legend: A Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mix of blasts and promonocytes. Promonocytes have more lobular and convoluted nuclear contours. Blasts and promonocytes have fine, lacy chromatin with prominent nucleoli and abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm.

Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate shows a mix of blasts and promonocytes: promonocytes have more lobular and convoluted nuclear contours; blasts and promonocytes have fine, lacy chromatin with prominent nucleoli and abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm (<<30681>>). Some blasts show cytoplasmic protrusions (Giemsa) (<<30682>>). Fine azurophilic granules can be present (<<30714>>).

diagnosis: Acute myelomonocytic leukaemia, flow cytometry dot plots
legend: Dot plots show the immunophenotype of blasts (red), immature monocytes (cyan), mature monocytes (purple), lymphocytes (light blue), and granulocytes (brown). The blasts show moderate CD45 and low side scatter on a log scale (A), bright CD34 and moderate CD33 (B), variable CD64 and CD117 (C), dim to negative (subset) CD36 (D), negative CD11c and CD14 (E), dim to negative (subset) CD11b and strong CD15 (F), strong CD13 (G), and bright HLA-DR (H) expression. Immature monocytes show relatively bright CD45 and side scatter that is higher than that of blasts but lower than that of granulocytes (A), bright CD33 (B), bright CD64 and negative CD117 (C), dim to negative CD36 (D), variable CD11c and dim to negative CD14 (E), moderate CD11b and CD15 (F), dim to negative CD13 (G), and moderate HLA-DR and CD14 (H) expression. Mature monocytes show bright CD45 and side scatter that is higher than that of blasts but lower than that of granulocytes (A), bright CD33 (B), bright CD64 and negative CD117 (C), moderate CD36 (D), moderate CD11c and CD14 (E), bright CD11b and dim to negative CD15 (F), dim to negative CD13 (G), and moderate to bright HLA-DR and CD14 (H) expression. Granulocytes show high side scatter, moderate CD45, CD33, dim CD64, dim CD11c, variable CD11b, variable CD13, and bright CD15 expression but are negative for CD34, CD117, CD36, CD14, and HLA-DR.
